top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children's files were missing healthcare professional statements.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Playground check sheets were not available.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5405)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The current gas leak inspection was not available.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Out of the eight children's files reviewed, six were missing a date of admission.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 child needs emergency care authorization to be redone due to water damage on form.
